name: EasyMonitor Self-Hosted Monitoring
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted website and API monitoring with HTTP, ICMP and TCP checks, SSL expiry alerts, multi-region probes, status pages and incident notifications; no vendor software quota or expiry stated.
watch_out: Requires self-operated Docker infrastructure with PostgreSQL/TimescaleDB, Redis and sufficient RAM (about 2 GB minimum). Remote probes, SMTP, storage, domains and optional third-party alert services may incur costs; no free managed hosting is included.
